ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Screenprint and Letterpress Workshops: This 2-credit course runs for 8 weeks (half the semester), and offers an introduction to screenprinting, letterpress, and use of the CNC router to create print matrices. Over the course of several projects, students will gain familiarity with the ink lab facilities, printmaking best practices, and conceptual concerns unique to print media. Students who successfully complete this class will be certified to access screenprinting and letterpress facilities in future semesters.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media major(s).
